why: Recent 2025-2026 arXiv papers resolve or disprove Kusner's conjecture for p>2 (including disproving it for all p>4 and proving it for 2<=p<=4), but for the L1 (p=1) case stated in this bullet, sources explicitly state it remains confirmed only for n<=4 with a general O(n log n) upper bound; no source claims a resolution or improved bound specifically for p=1.

found.title: Kusner's conjecture is false for p>4
found.note: Disproves conjecture for p>4; does not address p=1 (L1) case.

found.title: Kusner's conjecture: Exact values and linear bounds
found.note: Proves conjecture for 2<=p<=4 and near-linear bounds for other p ranges; states L1 (p=1) case still open beyond n<=4, with only O(n log n) bound known.

found.title: A counterexample to Kusner's conjecture on equilateral sets
found.note: Counterexample for p=5 (or similar non-1 exponent); not about L1 case.
